_comment: Single source of truth for every count and name that appears across the Tensor site, the Sovereign AI Standard site, the Hallmark visual system and the V-Seal guide. Edit here first; run standard/check-consistency.py to find documents that disagree.

dimensions.name: Model sovereignty
dimensions.question: Can you name it?
dimensions.tests: Supply-chain disclosure · version pinning · substitution notice · fallback capability

dimensions.name: Data sovereignty
dimensions.question: Can you move it?
dimensions.tests: Processing residency · sub-processor disclosure · cross-border transfer basis · government-access exposure

dimensions.name: Provenance sovereignty
dimensions.question: Can you defend it?
dimensions.tests: Training-corpus rights · retrieval source disclosure · output ownership · IP indemnity scope

dimensions.name: Operational sovereignty
dimensions.question: Can you steer it?
dimensions.tests: Change notice · evaluation rights · rollback · decision logging · human-review controls

dimensions.name: Infrastructure sovereignty
dimensions.question: Can you run it elsewhere?
dimensions.tests: Hosting and inference topology · provider concentration · customer-controlled deployment option · continuity on provider failure

dimensions.name: Exit sovereignty
dimensions.question: Can you leave it?
dimensions.tests: Portability of data, prompts and tuning · transition assistance · escrow · post-termination rights

dimensions.name: Evaluation sovereignty
dimensions.question: Can you evaluate it?
dimensions.tests: Evaluation transparency · independent evaluation rights · subgroup and bias evaluation · reproducible, independently verified results

tracks.name: Application layer
tracks.who: SaaS vendors, agents and copilots, vertical AI applications, systems integrators embedding third-party models

tracks.name: Model providers
tracks.who: Foundation-model developers, providers of general-purpose AI models, organisations publishing open-weight models commercially

levels.name: Disclosed
levels.claim: The buyer can see the whole picture.

levels.name: Controlled
levels.claim: The protections are in the contract, not the sales deck.

levels.name: Sovereign
levels.claim: The customer could operate independently of any single provider.

tensor_clause_library._comment: Tensor's own AI contract clause library. It is a Tensor product, not part of the Standard, so its count is independent of criteria_per_track. 'Thirty findings / thirty clauses' is correct wherever it refers to this library; 'twenty-eight' is correct wherever it refers to the Standard's criteria or questionnaire.
